Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We can offer you a price of €17.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

As a small shop, we like to keep things practical and clear for our customers. Everything is set up on our end to run your parts efficiently, and we look forward to working together on this order.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

sup:DEMO-C1.text:
Dear partner,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our proposal and are very keen to win your business and demonstrate our capabilities as a reliable, long-term partner. For this position, our offer includes a price of €16.00 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 45 days net, and delivery EXW. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. 

We look forward to the opportunity of working together and building a successful partnership with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. Please let us know if you have any questions.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.text:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Thank you for sharing the competitive landscape; our colleagues will address your request for a cost breakdown shortly. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

We are pleased to accommodate your request for DAP delivery and a shorter lead time of 35 days. Our updated Angebot stands at a price of €16.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP. In exchange for these enhanced terms, we request maintaining payment at 45 days, allowing us to offer a revised price of €16.70 per unit, which gives an alternative package of a price of €16.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP. Our offer is valid for 30 days.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
